chunks: But those who try to defeat Our signs are people of Hell.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people of Hell according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj highlights the active resistance of disbelievers who strive to nullify divine signs through arrogance and force, viewing their efforts as futile against God's will. It underscores the concept of 'Mu'ajizin' (those who try to outpace or overpower), linking their deliberate opposition to revelation with their ultimate destination in Hellfire, a theme often connected to the rejection of the Ahl al-Bayt's authority.
